bodies: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (AHERA Model Accreditation Plan)

exams.name: EPA Brownfields Environmental Job Training Program
exams.blurb: Grant-funded programme combining HAZWOPER, lead, asbestos and site-assessment training for workers entering brownfields remediation.

exams.name: EPA Lead Abatement Project Designer Certification
exams.blurb: Certification for designers preparing lead abatement project specifications and occupant-protection plans under 40 CFR Part 745.

exams.name: EPA Lead Abatement Supervisor Certification
exams.blurb: Certification for supervisors directing lead-based paint abatement crews, containment and clearance testing in target housing.

exams.name: EPA Lead Abatement Worker Certification
exams.blurb: Certification for workers performing permanent removal or enclosure of lead-based paint hazards in housing and child-occupied facilities.

exams.name: EPA Lead Dust Sampling Technician Certification
exams.blurb: Certification for technicians collecting lead dust-wipe clearance samples following renovation or abatement in target housing.

exams.name: EPA Lead Renovation, Repair and Painting Renovator Certification
exams.blurb: Eight-hour certification required for renovators disturbing lead paint in pre-1978 homes and child-occupied facilities under the RRP Rule.

exams.name: EPA Lead Risk Assessor Certification
exams.blurb: Certification for professionals performing lead risk assessments, hazard screens and recommendations for interim controls or abatement.

exams.name: EPA Lead-Based Paint Inspector Certification
exams.blurb: Certification for inspectors conducting surface-by-surface lead-based paint inspections using XRF analysers and paint chip sampling.

exams.name: ISA Board Certified Master Arborist
exams.blurb: Highest ISA credential, examining tree science, practice and management for arborists with extensive documented field experience.

exams.name: ISA Certified Arborist
exams.blurb: Core arboriculture certification covering tree biology, pruning, diagnosis, soil management, safety and tree risk fundamentals.

exams.name: ISA Certified Arborist Municipal Specialist
exams.blurb: Specialty credential for arborists managing public urban forests, tree ordinances, inventories and community forestry programmes.

exams.name: ISA Certified Arborist Utility Specialist
exams.blurb: Specialty credential for arborists managing vegetation around electric utility lines, covering clearance standards and outage prevention.

exams.name: ISA Certified Tree Worker Aerial Lift Specialist
exams.blurb: Skills and written certification for tree workers operating aerial lifts safely during pruning and removal operations.

exams.name: ISA Certified Tree Worker Climber Specialist
exams.blurb: Written and practical certification testing climbing systems, aerial rescue, chainsaw use and rigging for production tree workers.

exams.name: ISA Tree Risk Assessment Qualification
exams.blurb: Qualification course and assessment on the systematic tree risk assessment process, likelihood matrices and mitigation options.

exams.name: Certified Erosion, Sediment and Storm Water Inspector
exams.blurb: Certification for inspectors verifying erosion, sediment and stormwater control installation and maintenance on construction sites.

exams.name: Certified Professional in Erosion and Sediment Control
exams.blurb: Certification recognising expertise in soil erosion processes, sediment control design and construction site stormwater compliance.

exams.name: Certified Professional in Municipal Stormwater Management
exams.blurb: Certification for professionals administering MS4 permit programmes, illicit discharge detection and municipal stormwater planning.

exams.name: Certified Professional in StormWater Quality
exams.blurb: Certification covering watershed hydrology, pollutant transport and design of stormwater quality treatment and mitigation measures.

exams.name: National Green Infrastructure Certification Program
exams.blurb: Entry-level certification for workers constructing and maintaining bioretention, permeable paving and other green infrastructure.

exams.name: WQA Certified Installer
exams.blurb: Certification for professionals installing point-of-use and point-of-entry water treatment equipment to plumbing code requirements.

exams.name: WQA Certified Service Technician
exams.blurb: Certification for field technicians troubleshooting and servicing residential point-of-use and point-of-entry treatment systems.

exams.name: WQA Certified Water Specialist
exams.blurb: Certification for professionals specifying multistage treatment trains for residential problem water and health-related contaminants.

exams.name: WQA Certified Water Treatment Representative
exams.blurb: Core certification for representatives selling and configuring treatment options for aesthetic drinking water problems.

exams.name: WQA Master Water Specialist
exams.blurb: Advanced WQA credential requiring existing CWS certification, five years of experience and two advanced-level examinations.

exams.name: AHERA Asbestos Abatement Contractor/Supervisor Accreditation
exams.body: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (AHERA Model Accreditation Plan)
exams.blurb: Five-day AHERA accreditation for competent persons supervising asbestos abatement crews, containments and clearance procedures.

exams.name: AHERA Asbestos Abatement Worker Accreditation
exams.body: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (AHERA Model Accreditation Plan)
exams.blurb: Four-day initial accreditation required for workers performing asbestos removal, encapsulation and enclosure inside regulated areas.

exams.name: AHERA Asbestos Building Inspector Accreditation
exams.body: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (AHERA Model Accreditation Plan)
exams.blurb: AHERA accreditation for personnel who survey buildings, identify suspect asbestos-containing materials and collect bulk samples.

exams.name: AHERA Asbestos Management Planner Accreditation
exams.body: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (AHERA Model Accreditation Plan)
exams.blurb: AHERA accreditation for professionals who interpret inspection results and write asbestos management plans for school and public buildings.

exams.name: AHERA Asbestos Project Designer Accreditation
exams.body: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (AHERA Model Accreditation Plan)
exams.blurb: AHERA accreditation for designers who specify containment, engineering controls and work practices for asbestos abatement projects.

exams.name: Council-certified Indoor Environmental Consultant
exams.blurb: Board certification for consultants who investigate indoor air quality complaints and write remediation protocols for buildings.

exams.name: Council-certified Indoor Environmentalist
exams.blurb: Entry-level board certification covering indoor air quality assessment, ventilation evaluation and common building contaminants.

exams.name: Council-certified Microbial Consultant
exams.blurb: Advanced board certification for consultants who design mould remediation protocols and verify post-remediation clearance.

exams.name: Council-certified Microbial Investigator
exams.blurb: Board certification for investigators who inspect buildings for mould growth, moisture intrusion and microbial contamination.

exams.name: NRPP Radon Measurement Field Technician
exams.blurb: Certification for technicians who deploy and retrieve radon measurement devices under the oversight of a measurement professional.

exams.name: NRPP Radon Measurement Professional
exams.blurb: Certification for professionals conducting radon testing with analytical or passive devices and managing quality-assurance procedures.

exams.name: NRPP Radon Mitigation Installer
exams.blurb: Certification for installers building soil depressurisation systems under the supervision of a certified radon mitigation specialist.

exams.name: NRPP Radon Mitigation Specialist
exams.blurb: Certification for specialists who evaluate radon results and design, install and diagnose radon reduction systems to ANSI-AARST standards.
